items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Well believe me I was playing with Leverda in New York.

ctx.x: Is there anything about the tempo that is to me it seems sometimes they play everything faster. Well to mention one record that you made too I guess you remember the Tiger Rag Stampede. Oh yeah.
Well believe me I was playing with Leverda in New York. Now he plays just about twice that fast. Really? As we recorded it.
Yeah. But in the old age.
